confidence_notes: FX is the RBA observation for 2026-11-18, found by search. Food and drink anchors come from one aggregated cost-of-living search (CityCost, Numbeo-derived and similar sites), which showed a spread of values. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. Cocktail is estimated at about 2.5x the restaurant beer price and wine at about 3x, because alcohol is taxed heavily and varies by state in India, and tourist venues in Udaipur charge more. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Udaipur's tourist market. I did not inspect any listings or booking pages, and prices vary a lot by season and by lake-view location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Rajasthan tourist cities such as Jaipur and Jodhpur, with heritage-hotel and lake-view premiums in the old town.
